in_marathi.name: Chudasama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chudasama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Chudasama refers to the mountain where Lord Shiva and Parvati reside. It is believed that the moon god, Chandra, visits this mountain to bathe in the sacred river Ganga.
